games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: After a goal, a 5-second replay plays with a countdown and a Skip button so scoring is clear
Puck magnetism eases in after your last touch, so loose pucks feel more natural
Invite links and a pre-game lobby with teams (up to 4 phones in a phone-hosted match)
Softer, more natural track curves down the middle of the ice
Skaters use Justin's pose library with sticks in hand, upright skating, and cleaner fights
Everything from the earlier v0.9.57 playtest build is still here

games.name: Orbit Brawl
new: Xbox controller support: fly, aim, throttle, gun, bomb, and maneuvers from a gamepad
Kill cam plays out fully, then a short countdown before you relaunch
Hangar loadouts, long-escape maneuvers, invite links, and a rearview mirror
Strafe, heat-seeker bombs, aim assist, and a wide orbit replay camera
Proxy ship with a pilot in the cockpit, break-up debris, and synth SFX (with mute)
Fixes for freezes, stuck zoom, and hard-to-read text from earlier builds
